journal.heroSub: Practical guides on comfort, dimensions, construction and function — written to help you choose with clarity.
journal.quote: Better decisions start with understanding the details that decide how a sofa fits, feels and works in a real home.
journal.learnLead: A sofa can look perfect in a photo and still be the wrong choice for the way you sit, the room it goes into, or what you need it to do.
journal.learnSub2: No vague design talk — just clear, useful points to help you weigh the trade-offs, ask better questions and choose with confidence.
journal.learnSub: Photos and product titles rarely tell the whole story. These guides explain what to check, what to measure and what to ask before you order.
journal.beyondSub: Every guide focuses on what you can verify: measurements, materials and how a piece is built.

materials.introTitle: A material name alone does not determine the quality of a sofa.
materials.introSub: Two sofas described as “velvet” can feel and age very differently. Composition, weave, backing and construction matter as much as the name.

color.c1Sub: Deep piles look darker than flat weaves in the same dye.

foam.hrSub: Recovers its shape quickly and keeps support longer.
